title.zh: v2.11.1 皮肤收口：底色不会再被刷成墨色，强调色作为文字有可读版本，和弦页低对比从 129 降到 13
title.en: v2.11.1 Skin Clean-up: Surfaces Are No Longer Painted With Ink, the Accent Has a Readable Text Step, and the Chord Page's Low-Contrast Count Fell From 129 to 13

highlights.zh: **角色现在分「种类」了。** 生成器挑「最接近的角色」时只看颜色，不看这个工具类到底是底色、边框还是文字：于是浅色表面的字面值被归到**墨色**角色、发丝线的字面值被归到**填充**角色。在默认深色板下这看不出来，在浅色皮肤下就整个反过来——**漫画皮肤因此把自己的按钮刷成墨色、又用同一个墨色写字**（一页 30 处墨压墨）。现在底色类工具只能取表面/信号角色，边框类只能取线条/信号角色，文字类只能取墨色/信号角色，手写表里的条目也要过同一道种类检查。
highlights.en: **Roles have kinds now.** The generator's "nearest role" looked only at the colour, never at whether the utility is a ground, a border or type — so a light surface literal could land on the **ink** role and a hairline on a **fill**. Invisible under the default dark palette; completely inverted under a light skin, which is how the comic theme **painted a button with its own ink and then labelled it with the same ink** (30 elements of ink-on-ink on one page). Ground utilities…

highlights.zh: **`text-white` 与 `text-black` 不再是「字面白/黑」，而是「我所在底色的墨色」。** 这两个是 Tailwind 命名类，任何字面值扫描都看不到它们，而它们被写了上百处：`text-white` 压在**假定为深色**的板上（浅色皮肤下那块是纸，白字直接消失——单是工作室和弦页就有 48 处）；`text-black` 压在强调色实心上（最小皮肤的蓝底上只有 3.6:1）。现在 `text-white` 在**信号色实心**上取 `--d-on-accent`，其余情况取所在表面的墨色；`text-black` 取 `--d-on-accent`。
highlights.en: **`text-white` and `text-black` stop meaning literal white and black.** They are Tailwind *named* classes, so no literal scan sees them, and they are written in hundreds of places: `text-white` on plates the desktop **assumed were dark** (under a light skin that plate is paper and the label simply disappears — 48 of them in the chord workshop alone); `text-black` on an accent flood (3.6:1 on the minimal blue). `text-white` now takes `--d-on-accent` on a **signal** fill and t…

highlights.zh: **强调色分「实心」与「文字」两种用法。** 新增 `--d-accent-ink`：它只把强调色**移动到刚好**能在那块表面上达到 4.5:1 的程度——`bg-accent` 仍是原始强调色（实心块上的字用 `--d-on-accent`），而 `text-accent` 用这个可读版本。苏联岁月的国旗红在纸底只有 3.3:1，是最后一类成批出现的问题（71 处）；它的推导必须对着**表面**而不是卡片，第一版对着更亮的卡片算，判断为「已经够读」而放过了。
highlights.en: **The accent now has two jobs: a flood and type.** The new `--d-accent-ink` moves the accent **only as far as it needs** to clear 4.5:1 on the surface it is read on — `bg-accent` keeps the raw accent (its label taking `--d-on-accent`), while `text-accent` uses the readable step. The Soviet-years flag red is 3.3:1 on paper, and that was the last class appearing in bulk (71 elements).
